title: Set up customer support
summary: Configure customer messaging, a help center, and ticket management. Intercom is the canonical route; the support arena ranks the alternatives.

parts.title: Create your support platform account
parts.guidance: Choose the support workspace from the channels, existing contact addresses, team size and access needs. Check plan costs and how customer conversations and attachments are handled. Set company ownership, recovery access and administrators within the support budget. Before connecting a customer channel, assign who monitors it and what coverage the team can actually provide.

execution.rationale: Intercom documents business-email signup, workspace setup, plan checkout, teammate administration and recovery controls. Company administrators retain verification and personal authentication; the support owner approves coverage and charges. Contract subscriptions require account-manager handling for changes rather than self-service checkout.

parts.title: Install Messenger widget
parts.guidance: Place the support widget where customers need help and limit the identity and page data it sends to the agreed fields. Use the provider's current installation instructions. In preview, test keyboard access, display, signed-in identity and conversation creation. After the authorized site release, send a controlled live request and verify it reaches the right inbox without exposing another customer's messages.

execution.rationale: An engineer installs the widget, performs preview checks, releases the authorized version and verifies the controlled live request in the actual support inbox.

parts.title: Set up inbox and routing
parts.guidance: Route each channel and request type to a responsible person or team. Define reassignment, working hours and urgent-case escalation from the coverage available. Try sample requests from every entry point, including an unmatched case and an unavailable assignee. Check the fallback reaches someone who can act before switching live traffic to the new routing.

execution.rationale: Intercom documents team inboxes, office hours and routing workflows for the approved support coverage.

parts.title: Create help center articles
parts.guidance: Write help articles for recurring questions, real product tasks and known failures. Use the current interface and include prerequisites, screenshots and links where they help someone complete the task. Have a support or product reviewer follow the instructions and remove internal or customer information. Publish the reviewed version, check that users can find it, and assign responsibility for updates when the product changes.

execution.rationale: The surrounding support setup selects Intercom. Its article editor supports drafts, preview, publication and collection placement for public search; the reviewed article can be opened at its actual help-center URL. Product review and ownership of later updates remain with the responsible team.

parts.title: Configure auto-responses
parts.guidance: Write automatic replies that match support coverage, with triggers and safeguards against repeated responses. Use response and resolution commitments agreed by the team. Test normal, repeated and out-of-hours requests, then activate the support owner's agreed messages and routing rules.

execution.rationale: Intercom documents automatic email replies and office-hour behavior for the approved support messages.

parts.title: Add team members
parts.guidance: Map named teammates to the support tasks they need, then choose administrator, agent or viewer access accordingly. Check any added seat charges against the support budget before sending the agreed invitations. Verify accepted memberships and a sample assignment. Give the access owner the final membership list so role changes and departures can be handled later.

execution.rationale: Intercom's teammate settings expose inbox membership and permissions for testing the intended support roles.

metadata.supportReason: Intercom has comprehensive API for messaging and contact management. Initial setup and article creation need human input.
